model.architecture: Cohere's 2.48B VLM: a 400M SigLIP2-SO400M-scale vision tower (Qwen3-VL-style encoder with DeepStack mergers) feeding a 2B Cohere decoder, trained for 11 languages.

variants.quantization: int4 blockwise-32 decoder; int8 externalized embedder; mixed-precision activations (fp32_fp16) declared in-bundle; vision tower int8 weights; adapter int8

recommended.reason: the Android path verified on a Galaxy S26 (S4 gate 2026-08-25): full delegation (5344 ops across 4 subgraphs) and a correct answer to the probe; 13.3 tok/s decode, engine init 6.9 s, peak 1787 MB. No same-device CPU control was taken, so this is the verified choice for the class, not a measured win over CPU; the repo's North-Micro-Vision-Instruct_wi8.litertlm decodes 11.06 tok/s on the same device and backend, so this file carries the class

platform_notes: Context (KV cache) 4096; image resized to 512x512 -> 256 image tokens; DeepStack folded into the single image embedding.

Decoder declares prefer_activation_type = fp32_fp16: some mobile GPUs accumulate fp16 and overflow at image-token positions (blanking the vision conditioning); the in-bundle declaration selects mixed precision automatically.

No GATHER_ND (mobile GPU delegate cannot compile it); every activation keeps a leading batch dim (rank >=3), required for correct results on the Metal GPU delegate; LayerNorm inputs pre-scaled so the tower survives fp16 GPU precision.
Galaxy S26 GPU gate covers engine creation and the text path only (no image in the gate prompt); the vision path on the GPU is not measured there. XNNPACK takes 1 of 4 nodes in main.
Swift runtime (iPhone/macOS): load with the vision tower enabled (Modality.textImage); vision-only bundle (no audio tower) — bring the engine up with the vision modality only.
Size-constrained variant (2.19 GB); wi8 is the primary file.

measured.source: S4 GPU gate, 205-token benchmark, single run; full delegation (5344 ops across 4 subgraphs); generation gate answered the probe correctly. No same-device CPU control was taken, so this is a GPU speed, not a measured win over CPU.

known_issues: fast_vlm contract folds the DeepStack embeddings and replaces M-RoPE with 1-D positions: describe/VQA/spatial/single-cell lookup preserved, but 2-D table cross-cell questions and digit-dense OCR degrade — don't rely on it to rank table cells.
One image per chat: send each image in a fresh conversation, as with the other fast_vlm bundles.
8-question text gate 7/8: the one miss ('17 + 25' read as '1.7 + 2.5') reproduces token-for-token on the HF fp32 model — Cohere's per-digit pre-tokenizer, not a conversion artifact.
Before 2026-08-31 the chat template matched history turns only on role 'model', so Conversation-API history with role 'assistant' was silently dropped; fixed, metadata-only (LiteRT-LM#3417).
int4 variant: coherent and content-correct on all 9 suite cases but terser and further from the fp32 wording; prefer wi8 where storage allows.

variants.quantization: int8 dynamic weights (wi8) decoder; int8 externalized embedder; mixed-precision activations (fp32_fp16) declared in-bundle; vision tower int8 weights; adapter int8

recommended.reason: the Android path measured on a Pixel 8a (Tensor G3): 6.4 tok/s decode on gpu; no same-device control on the other backend, so this is the verified choice for the class, not a measured win
